app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The payment service is missing its payment-provider credentials (token) in the pod environment / secrets. As a result every charge attempt fails with the provider error "Payment request failed. Invalid token" and returns gRPC INTERNAL errors propagated to users. Evidence: (1) frontend-proxy traces show repeated payment failures with error "Payment request failed. Invalid token"; (2) payment pod logs contain repeated warnings: "Payment request failed. Invalid token. demo.user_context.loyalty_level=gold"; (3) the payment Deployment manifest contains no environment variable or secret reference for a payment provider token/credentials; (4) there is no dedicated payment secret in the namespace secrets list. Together this shows the payment component was never given the token, causing all charge calls to fail.
